authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

value: Current optimized Lord evidence is Infect/Voltron, not sacrifice; keep the sacrifice shell as backup (decisions L33).
Dictate of Erebos cut on the adversarial pass (decisions).

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Unsuppressed trigger costs two creatures, 2 life and gives an opponent two cards.
A 10/4 dies to most removal and can be chump-blocked.
Torpor Orb also stops your own ETB creatures.

value.interaction: Cheap removal and stack interaction (Terminate, Deadly Rollick, Sheoldred's Edict, Stifle, Muddle the Mixture, Toxic Deluge).
value.mana: Four-mana commander; Sol Ring, Signets, Talismans.
value.protection: Boots/Greaves, Not of This World, Slip Out the Back, Stubborn Denial, Deflecting Swat.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Lord's 10 power is the kill; the infect and double-strike cards only work on him.
accepted_role.honest_note: The enter trigger is a real cost: lose 2, sacrifice two creatures (Lord himself if needed; regeneration doesn't help) and an opponent draws two (M1 tresserhorn-01). The source admits the Torpor Orb/Karn slots trade away flexibility (tresserhorn-13). The sacrifice loops win without him.
